title: HouseEvents
description: POST /events of the Jetson learner (jetson/learner/server.py, D38): a batch of what happened in the house, forwarded by the add-on (app/core/learner.py). The add-on tags each change with its cause the way core/insights.py reads the logbook; live changes are tagged from their HA context, a backfill from the logbook. Numeric sensors arrive at most once a minute per entity (the last value). The learner never sees an HA token and never writes to HA.

backfill.description: true = read from HA's logbook to fill a gap, not live

kind.description: state = an entity changed state; trigger = an automation or script ran (entity_id is the automation); answer = the owner pressed a button of an ask notification (state is the button's action id)

cause.description: core/insights.py Change.cause: user = a person in the HA UI or app; physical = no context at all (a wall switch, or a sensor's own change); agent = Agent House; automation = an HA automation or a program user (Node-RED …); script; other

ref.description: automation/script entity, `user:<program name>`, or the agent id
